Container.Name: Magpie
Container.Overview: A minimal, self-hosted bookmark manager: nested collections, tags, full-text search, a reader view, import/export, daily backups and a browser extension. One Node process and one SQLite file. Open the Web UI and create your account; the first account is the administrator. Then set "Disable sign-ups" to true.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web app, API and browser extension. Change the host port if 3000 is taken (Grafana uses it too).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database (magpie.db), uploaded files, cached previews and backups. SQLite is safest off Unraid's /mnt/user FUSE layer: this default is fine when appdata is an exclusive share (Unraid 6.12+); otherwise use the pool path directly, e.g. /mnt/cache/appdata/magpie.

Config.Name: Disable sign-ups
Config.Description: Set to true once you've created your account, to block new ones.

Config.Name: Fetch LAN links
Config.Description: Allow fetching titles and previews for links on your local network (e.g. http://tower.local:8080). Off by default so the server can't be used to probe your network; such links are still saved, just without metadata.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the data folder. 99 is Unraid's 'nobody'.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the data folder. 100 is Unraid's 'users'.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions mask for new files in the data folder.

Config.Name: Backups to keep
Config.Description: Automatic daily backups kept per user.
